calamares_oem_setup.description: If true, Calamares refers to itself as a setup program rather than an installer

calamares_disable_cancel.description: If true, disables the Cancel button entirely

calamares_disable_cancel_during_exec.description: If true, disables Cancel button after installation starts

calamares_quit_at_end.description: If true, Calamares quits automatically at end of sequence

calamares_prompt_install.description: If true, shows 'Are you sure?' prompt before each execution phase

calamares_dont_chroot.description: If true, execute commands without chroot (for post-install tools)
